name: popsicle
headline: Dynamic Month & Year: WordPress SEO Automation
short_description: Add today’s date by [date], current year by [year], previous year by [pyear], next year by [nyear] and current month by [month] shortcodes anywhere, including content and title. Use this plugin to boost your site’s SEO by using the variables anywhere.
author: wpgaurav

sections.overview:
Dynamic Month & Year into Posts is a WordPress plugin that keeps your content fresh automatically using shortcodes like [year], [month], [date], [age], and [daysuntil]. Insert these shortcodes anywhere—in post content, titles, and meta descriptions—to display current or relative dates without manual updates. Perfect for affiliate marketers, bloggers, and content creators who need evergreen content that stays relevant. The plugin supports age calculations, countdown timers, seasonal content, and Black Friday/Cyber Monday auto-calculation. Features include dedicated Gutenberg blocks for live preview, a Block Editor toolbar button for quick insertion, and full control over date formatting for different regions and hemispheres.
Display years of experience in author bios automatically
Create evergreen 'current year' content for SEO (e.g., '[year] Marketing Guide')
Show countdowns to seasonal sales or product launches
Track age/anniversaries with ordinal suffixes (e.g., '35th anniversary')
